function relocate_navigation_blocked_geometry!(env)
    zone_keys = Symbol[p.first for p in active_restriction_zones()]
    isempty(zone_keys) && return (; status = :success)

    zone_diagnoses(env; check_restage = true, check_teams = true)
    before = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)

    if before.n_blocked > 0 || before.n_agent_trapped > 0 || before.project_blocked
        moved = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
        if moved.status === :infeasible || moved.status === :no_staging
            error("No legal scene-tree relocation was found")
        end

        after = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
        if after.n_blocked > 0 || after.n_agent_trapped > 0 || after.project_blocked
            error("Scene-tree relocation left navigation-dependent schedule nodes blocked")
        end

        zone_diagnoses(env; check_restage = true, check_teams = true)
    end

    return (; status = :success)
end
